interface.longDescription: Generate a five- to 47-second music cue from a scene, mood and instrumentation brief. Listen and download the audio inline. Instrumental output is requested, but musical details and duration may vary. This does not copy artists, clone voices, synchronize music to video or guarantee exclusivity or licensing rights. A connected Firemoon account is required.
defaultPrompt: Make a 20-second gentle piano cue for a quiet morning scene.
Create a five-second upbeat percussion cue without vocals.
